name: start-on-a-dead-task
guard: StartStep(s) needs a live task

name: finish-step-on-a-dead-task
guard: FinishStep(s) needs a live task

name: complete-on-a-dead-task
guard: Complete needs a live task

name: terminal-on-a-dead-task
guard: UserTerminal needs a live task

name: start-during-a-saga
guard: no forward step starts once the saga began

name: finish-step-during-a-saga
guard: no forward step commits once the saga began

name: complete-during-a-saga
guard: a rolling-back task cannot complete

name: terminal-decided-twice
guard: the terminal decision is made once

name: start-a-started-step
guard: a step starts once and keeps its index

name: marker-after-the-body
guard: the start marker commits before the step body runs

name: start-hides-the-effect
guard: a step that starts may have had its effect, so its rollback has something to compensate

name: start-reuses-an-index
guard: a start takes an index above every other
find:
THEN /\ fwd' = [fwd EXCEPT ![s] = "started"]
          /\ startIdx' = [startIdx EXCEPT ![s] = TopIdx + 1]

name: finish-an-unstarted-step
guard: only a started step commits its result

name: decision-without-the-marker
guard: the terminal decision and the phase marker are one batch

name: infra-cap-on-a-dead-task
guard: a sweep fails only a live task

name: infra-cap-reenters-a-saga
guard: an infrastructure cap inside a saga halts it and decides nothing new

name: infra-cap-always-skips
guard: with the rule TRUE an infrastructure cap rolls back

name: infra-cap-always-rolls-back
guard: with the rule FALSE an infrastructure cap skips the saga

name: infra-halt-hides-the-outcome
guard: a saga an infrastructure cap ends records an outcome
find: ELSE task' = "failed" /\ outcome' = HaltOutcome /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, cause>>

name: rollback-on-a-dead-task
guard: RunRollback(s) needs a live task

name: rollback-before-the-decision
guard: RunRollback(s) needs the rolling-back phase

name: retry-on-a-dead-task
guard: RollbackRetry(s) needs a live task

name: retry-before-the-decision
guard: RollbackRetry(s) needs the rolling-back phase

name: halt-on-a-dead-task
guard: RollbackHalts(s) needs a live task

name: halt-before-the-decision
guard: RollbackHalts(s) needs the rolling-back phase

name: finish-saga-on-a-dead-task
guard: FinishSaga needs a live task

name: finish-saga-before-the-decision
guard: FinishSaga needs the rolling-back phase

name: rollback-out-of-order
guard: the next rollback is the pending step that started last

name: rollback-of-an-unregistered-step
guard: only a registered step is rolled back

name: rollback-of-an-unstarted-step
guard: only a step that started is rolled back

name: rollback-runs-twice
guard: a rollback that is done is not pending. RollbackIsFinal holds it because a done rollback left pending can still fail for good, and DecisionSettles holds it too, because the saga never finishes

name: retry-past-the-budget
guard: a rollback retries only within its own budget

name: rollback-refills-its-budget
guard: within a saga generation a rollback's spent attempts are never given back
find:
/\ effect' = [effect EXCEPT ![s] = "gone"]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<task, phase, fwd, startIdx, rbTries, outcome, cause, revivals, generation, owed>>
replace:
/\ effect' = [effect EXCEPT ![s] = "gone"]
  /\ rbTries' = [rbTries EXCEPT ![s] = 0]
  /\ UNCHANGED <<task, phase, fwd, startIdx, outcome, cause, revivals, generation, owed>>

name: halt-hides-the-outcome
guard: a halted saga records a failed outcome
find:
/\ outcome' = "failed" /\ task' = "failed"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, fwd, startIdx, rbTries, cause,
replace:
/\ task' = "failed"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<outcome, phase, fwd, startIdx, rbTries, cause,

name: halt-leaves-the-task-live
guard: a halt ends the task in the same batch
find:
/\ outcome' = "failed" /\ task' = "failed"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<phase, fwd, startIdx, rbTries, cause,
replace:
/\ outcome' = "failed"
  /\ UNCHANGED <<task, phase, fwd, startIdx, rbTries, cause,

name: finish-with-rollbacks-pending
guard: a saga completes only with nothing pending

name: finish-saga-only-when-empty
guard: a saga whose rollbacks are all done finishes

name: cancel-a-dead-task
guard: only a live task is cancelled

name: cancel-ignores-the-rule
guard: under "refused" a rolling-back task is not cancelled

name: cancel-hides-the-halt
guard: a cancellation that ends a saga records an outcome
find: /\ outcome' = IF phase = "rolling_back" THEN HaltOutcome ELSE outcome

name: early-end-always-says-failed
guard: a saga that ends early with nothing left uncompensated records complete
find: HaltOutcome == IF \E s \in Eligible : rb[s] # "done" THEN "failed" ELSE "complete"

name: early-end-always-says-complete
guard: a saga that ends early with a step left uncompensated records failed
find: HaltOutcome == IF \E s \in Eligible : rb[s] # "done" THEN "failed" ELSE "complete"

name: revive-a-live-task
guard: only a failed task revives

name: revive-past-the-budget
guard: revivals are bounded, which only keeps the model finite

name: revive-keeps-the-cause
guard: a revival clears the decision

name: revive-ignores-the-rule
guard: under "refused" a task whose saga began is not revived

name: revive-a-halted-saga
guard: only a completed saga is revived

name: revive-stays-in-the-saga
guard: a revival returns the task to the forward phase

name: revive-keeps-the-outcome
guard: a revival clears the rollback outcome

name: revive-keeps-the-generation
guard: a revival after a saga starts a new generation

name: revive-keeps-the-memo
guard: a revival forgets every rolled-back step, or replay would skip a step whose effect is gone
find: /\ fwd' = [s \in Steps |-> IF s \in Eligible THEN "none" ELSE fwd[s]]

name: revive-keeps-the-order
guard: a forgotten step gives up its index
find: /\ startIdx' = [s \in Steps |-> IF s \in Eligible THEN 0 ELSE startIdx[s]]

name: revive-keeps-the-rollbacks
guard: a new generation starts with no rollback done, or a step that runs again finds its rollback already done

name: revive-keeps-the-tries
guard: a new generation starts with fresh rollback budgets. Bookkeeping invariants alone hold this, and no soundness property speaks for it

name: halt-recorded-as-done
guard: a rollback that failed for good is not recorded as done

name: cancel-writes-an-unknown-state
guard: every state a batch writes is one the model knows
